title: Sacrificing an animal that is no longer able to breed
question: If an animal is no longer able to bear young on account of its advanced age, will its sacrifice be valid or not?
answer:
The sacrifice of such an animal is permissible. (Fatāwā ʿĀlamgīriyyah: 5/297).

واللہ سبحانہ و تعالی اعلم
